name: What should I look for when choosing a stucco repair contractor?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a stucco repair contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a stucco repair contractor, look for licensed and insured professionals with a strong local reputation. Check for experience specifically with stucco systems, ask for references, and review their portfolio of completed projects. A reliable contractor will provide a detailed, written estimate, explain their repair process, and offer warranties on their work. Clear communication and transparency are also key indicators of a trustworthy company.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose licensed, insured contractors with local experience, good references, a portfolio, clear estimates, and warranties.
